notes: Planner, brief, generator, and legacy refactor readiness must be read from page-family-workflows.manifest.json.
This contract freezes v1 scope and public boundaries, but it is not the execution readiness source of truth.
supportedArchetypes here means internal coordination-pattern contracts for execution planning, not page-template or screenshot-example enumeration.
When inputMode is figma-design-restore, upper layers must provide confirmedDesignRestoreInput before brief creation.
When inputMode is figma-design-restore, nonTypicalExecutionBrief must materialize restorePrimitivePlan from confirmedDesignRestoreInput.restoreDecisionPackage.
design-screenshot-restore remains reserved for the second-stage degraded lane and is not publicly open yet.

stopRules: stop when the page can still be covered by an existing typical-page or analytics-page family
stop when the page only looks unusual because it adds side regions or control regions, but a classic table, form, or detail still remains the primary carrier
stop when pageHeaderPlan or whiteBodyPlan cannot be formed clearly
stop when the host cannot provide a stretchable mount region
stop when primaryRegion is not unique
stop when stableRegions and mutableRegions cannot be separated clearly
stop when the primary cross-region coordination cannot be explained clearly
stop when critical interactions require an unproven third-party canvas or host-only runtime
stop when design system sources cannot be mapped back to HiUI5 or local-managed-runtime
stop when the request attempts to bypass current legacyRefactorReady=false or v1 scope-frozen boundaries
do not stop only because shared host header collapse is unproven when page-owned suppression is available
lightSanityChecklist: primary workflows are limited to core paths
stable and mutable regions are declared separately
preferredSources remain inside the approved design system
approvedEscapes is empty unless explicitly justified
design-restore inputs must produce a non-empty restorePrimitivePlan.regionBindings
